mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate indicates an accommodative monetary policy, which may stimulate economic growth and lead to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not higher than baseline during periods of low FEDFUNDS.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in unemployment rate above 6% signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX returns remain positive when UNRATE exceeds 6%.

mechanism_narrative: Rising FEDFUNDS and UNRATE together indicate tightening that could slow growth, leading to negative returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: Positive returns occur despite rising FEDFUNDS and UNRATE.

mechanism_narrative: In a tightening cycle, higher FEDFUNDS predicts negative returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: Returns remain positive when FEDFUNDS rises in a tightening cycle.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing housing starts indicate strong demand, leading to positive returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: Returns are not positive when HOUST increases.

mechanism_narrative: A drop in industrial production below 90 indicates supply issues, leading to negative returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Positive returns occur when INDPRO is below 90.

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth with rising CPI may signal inflation, leading to negative returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: Positive returns occur despite GDP and CPI growth.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing payroll employment signals economic strength, leading to positive returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: Returns are not positive when PAYEMS increases.
